name: The Royal Sonesta San Juan
positioning: Beachfront resort on Isla Verde Beach in San Juan, with direct beach access, a lagoon-style pool and an oceanfront spa
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right on a calm, swimmable San Juan beach
Couples looking for oceanfront spa time and ocean-view balconies
Visitors who want a beach base with guided tours of San Juan on offer

facts.text: The hotel is on Isla Verde Beach in the Isla Verde neighborhood of San Juan.
Isla Verde Beach has calm, swimmable waters along a long stretch of golden sand lined with shops and restaurants.
Rooms and suites have ocean, garden, pool or city views.
Room decor is inspired by the island's golden sands and turquoise waters.
Rooms have walk-in showers with rainforest shower heads.
Room types include Club rooms, Club Suites and a Presidential Suite.
Spa offerings at Zen Spa Brisas include massages, body treatments, facials, relaxation lounges and a salon.
The oceanfront fitness center is open 24/7 and has ocean views.
Karaya Lobby Bar & Terrace serves locally inspired tapas and handcrafted cocktails with views of the lagoon pool and fire pits.
Sottovento Ristorante is an Italian fine-dining restaurant using locally sourced ingredients.
Castillo San Felipe del Morro, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is 7.4 miles from the resort.
The hotel offers expert-led guided tours of San Juan.

highlights.text: Guests have direct access to the golden sands of Isla Verde Beach from the hotel.
The hotel has a free-form lagoon-style pool with a swim-up bar.
Zen Spa Brisas is an oceanfront spa where the sound of the waves accompanies the treatments.
The King Ocean View room has a private balcony overlooking the ocean.
La Plazoleta de Isla Verde, a plaza with local food, music and entertainment, is steps from the resort.

considerations.text: Room rates are subject to a daily resort fee of 22% plus taxes; it includes beachfront access with towels, beach chairs and umbrellas.
The hotel is a beach base rather than a historic-district stay: Old San Juan is 7 miles from the resort.
WhataHotel notes Isla Verde is a high-traffic tourist area with a busy beach.
